title.en: Enter the promo code to claim FunNow credit

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟連結（連結會前往優惠碼頁面）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the link (it leads to the promo-code page).

steps.zh-TW: 確認優惠碼為 CGQ86GG；若沒有帶入，請手動輸入。
steps.en: Check that the promo code is CGQ86GG; if it is not filled in, enter it manually.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊並領取享樂金。
steps.en: Finish registering and claim the credit.

intro.zh-TW: 用 FunNow 預訂吃喝玩樂：輸入優惠碼 CGQ86GG 領取享樂金。
intro.en: Book food, drink and fun with FunNow: enter promo code CGQ86GG to claim FunNow credit.

description.zh-TW: FunNow 是可以預訂吃喝玩樂的服務。本頁的連結會前往 FunNow 的優惠碼頁面，優惠碼為 CGQ86GG；若頁面沒有帶入，請手動輸入。輸入優惠碼後可領取享樂金，實際金額、使用條件與期限以官方公告為準。優惠碼已包含在連結中，完成註冊後即可領取享樂金。
description.en: FunNow is a service for booking food, drink and fun. The link on this page leads to the FunNow promo-code page, and the promo code is CGQ86GG; if the page does not fill it in, enter it manually. Entering the code lets you claim FunNow credit, and the amount, conditions and deadline follow the official announcements. The promo code is already part of the link, and the credit can be claimed once registration is finished.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠碼已包含在連結中。享樂金的金額與使用條件以 FunNow 官方說明為準。
notes.en: The promo code is already part of the link. Credit amounts and conditions follow FunNow's official terms.
